Verification Report — Amplitude Control

This document is the verification report for amplitude control. Each result is a Verification Evidence entity (EVD-), shown here by a live query block (provenance-ddf DES-0032), and the builds and equipment are gathered from them the same way. The sections that check for failures, missing executions and deviations are queries too, so an empty section is a clean result rather than an author's assurance.

Purpose

To record the execution of the procedures in DOC-0004, on which build of the device and with which equipment, and to conclude whether the amplitude control requirements are verified.

Scope

This report covers every recorded execution of the approved procedures in DOC-0004. The procedures executed:

  • VER-0001
  • VER-0002

Requirements outside DOC-0004's scope are outside this report's too.

Device Under Test

The builds the procedures were executed on: the device under test and the version of it actually tested, each listed once with the executions run on it, in Table 1:

Test equipment

The equipment the executions used, each listed once with every unit of it used — serial number, calibration due date and the execution — in Table 2. Each unit is an equipment record on the execution, linked to the equipment DOC-0004's procedures say they need:

Results

Every execution, in the order it was run, with each step of its protocol beside the result recorded for it:

EVD-0001 Execution record — closed-loop amplitude adjustment bench test

pass · executed 2026-08-04 · tests VER-0001 at commit 145edd3

Build testedBLD-0001: Pulse generator, engineering build B, HW rev B, FW 1.3.0 — a build of CMP-0001

Steps

StepDescriptionAcceptance criteriaResultPass/Fail

Place the implant in the saline tank, connect its sense electrode to the bench ECAP simulator and clip the precision current probe onto the stimulation lead. Program a fixed amplitude of 3 mA in open loop.

The simulator detects an evoked response on every stimulation cycle, and the probe reads 3 mA ± 2 %.

Evoked response on every cycle; probe read 3.02 mA, as in Figure 1.

 pass

Configure the target band from the clinician settings and enable closed-loop control.

The implant reports closed-loop mode, and the target band it reads back matches the band configured.

Closed-loop mode reported; target band read back as configured.

 pass

Replay response profile 1, posture change from supine to standing, for 10 minutes.

The evoked response is within the target band on at least 99 % of cycles, and delivered amplitude stays within the configured range.

Within the target band on 99.7 % of cycles; amplitude 2.1–4.4 mA. The only excursions are at the two posture changes, in Figure 2.

 pass

Replay response profile 2, a slow increase in neural sensitivity, for 10 minutes.

The evoked response is within the target band on at least 99 % of cycles, and delivered amplitude stays within the configured range.

Within the target band on 99.8 % of cycles; amplitude 2.6–3.9 mA.

 pass

Replay response profile 3, transient responses from coughing, for 10 minutes.

The evoked response returns to the target band within 5 cycles of each transient, and delivered amplitude stays within the configured range.

Back in the target band within 3 cycles of every transient; amplitude 2.4–4.1 mA.

 pass

EquipmentSerial numberCalibration due date

Notes

EVD-0002 Execution record — single-fault amplitude ceiling bench test

pass · executed 2026-08-11 · tests VER-0002 at commit 145edd3

Build testedBLD-0002: Pulse generator, engineering build B2, HW rev B, FW 1.3.1 — a build of CMP-0001

Steps

StepDescriptionAcceptance criteriaResultPass/Fail

Connect the implant's sense electrode through the fault-injection lead simulator, with its current monitor on the stimulation lead. Enable closed-loop control with the amplitude at its configured maximum.

The current monitor reads the configured maximum amplitude, within ± 2 %.

Current monitor read 7.04 mA against a configured maximum of 7 mA.

 pass

Through the test interface, command an amplitude of 10 mA, above the ceiling.

Delivered amplitude does not exceed 8 mA.

Delivered amplitude held at 7.9 mA; the ceiling engaged.

 pass

Disconnect the sense electrode during active stimulation, hold for 30 seconds and reconnect. Repeat for ten trials.

Delivered amplitude does not exceed 8 mA at any time in any of the ten trials.

Peak delivered amplitude 7.9 mA across the ten trials. Every trial looked like trial 4, in Figure 4: with the lead open the loop drives amplitude up, and the hardware limit holds it below the ceiling until the lead is reconnected.

 pass

Executed against the protocol as revised by ECO-0001, including the lead-disconnection fault-injection step. Delivered amplitude did not exceed 7.9 mA across ten trials. Had BLD-0002's build_date been after this execution's, rules/evidence-after-build.yaml would flag it.

Conclusion

While the sections above are empty, every procedure in DOC-0004 has passed, on builds that existed when it ran and with calibrated equipment, and REQ-0001 and REQ-0002 are verified by test. EVD-0002 is the evidence the risk-benefit analysis of RSK-0001 waits on: delivered amplitude stayed under the 8 mA ceiling with the sense electrode disconnected, the single-fault condition of [1]. Re-assessing the residual risk belongs to the risk file, not to this report.

REQ-0003 is not verified by this report; see DOC-0004's scope.
